meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: Claude会将旧版NanoClaw和Claude记忆文件(如CLAUDE.md、.seed.md)迁移到统一的记忆文件夹,整理归类并建立索引,让切换工具后记忆自动保留。
howto.when: 更新后提示共享记忆格式变化,或发现旧版记忆文件(如.seed.md、CLAUDE.md等)时触发;也可通过说“迁移记忆”、“遗留记忆”等话术唤起。

say.note: Claude会开始扫描并迁移旧记忆文件。

say.text: 发现CLAUDE.md了,帮我合并到新记忆。
say.note: Claude会整理并归入统一记忆树。

say.text: 切换后我什么都不记得了。
say.note: Claude会检查并迁移遗留记忆。

howto.what_en: Claude migrates legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, .seed.md) into a unified memory tree, organizes them, and builds an index so memory is automatically retained after provider switches.
howto.when_en: Triggers after an update reports shared-memory breaking changes, when legacy files (.seed.md, CLAUDE.md, etc.) exist, or when the user says 'migrate memory', 'legacy memory', or mentions forgetting everything after a switch.

say_en.note: Claude will scan and migrate legacy memory files.

say_en.text: CLAUDE.md found; merge it into new memory.
say_en.note: Claude will organize it into the unified memory tree.

say_en.text: I remember nothing after the switch.
say_en.note: Claude will check and migrate legacy memory.
